name: othername-san-non-string-inner-critical-permit-invalid
description: Intermediate CA carries a critical permittedSubtrees with a single otherName entry for OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.99999.1 whose value is INTEGER 1. The leaf carries a SAN otherName for the same OID but with a different non-string inner value (an empty SEQUENCE). The constrained otherName form IS present in the leaf — same type-id OID — so the permit applies; the leaf's name does not satisfy the permit, and the critical-unknown-form rule additionally argues for fail-closed handling. Either way the chain must be rejected. Botan <3.12 silently dropped otherName SAN values whose inner ASN.1 was not a string, so this leaf appeared to have no otherName, the permit had no name of its form to apply to, and the chain was accepted in violation of RFC 5280 4.2.1.10.
references: Botan 1fd0f37747 — Properly decode OtherName and registeredID fields
notes: Permit otherName value: INTEGER { 1 }. Leaf otherName SAN value: empty SEQUENCE. Both are valid DER but neither parses as a string under pyca cryptography's OtherName handling; we inject both extensions via unknown_extensions to keep the non-string inner values intact.

Companion to othername-san-with-critical-unknown-constraint-invalid, which uses ia5-string inner values that pyca cryptography can encode through the regular DSL path. This case exercises the additional path where Botan dropped the SAN at decode time.
